productivity_screen.purpose: Focus-oriented display of the current time, today's schedule, and pending tasks.

layout.left_pane: 120x220: Large time display. Top text shows current date/day. Beneath is massive digital clock. Bottom text shows next upcoming alarm or timer.
layout.right_pane: 180x220: Now/Next Agenda layout. Top half shows current meeting/task. Bottom half shows next 2 tasks in a compact list format.

productivity_screen.motion: Colon in time pulses at 1Hz. Progress bar on the active task advances slowly based on current time.
productivity_screen.interactions: Tap the current task to mark as complete/dismiss.
productivity_screen.rendering_notes: Use a fixed-width custom font for the clock to avoid layout shifting on tick. The active task card should have a solid background, while upcoming tasks have an invisible background and border separator.
productivity_screen.prompt: A modern desk productivity dashboard on a 320x240 LCD. Left column has a giant digital clock reading 18:45 and the date in neon blue. Right column has a clean agenda UI showing an active 'Weekly Team Sync' meeting inside a highlighted card, and a subtle list of upcoming tasks beneath it. Background is dark charcoal. It looks hyper-organized and focused, like a premium smart desk clock interface.
productivity_screen.motion_prompt: The colon on the clock blinks precisely every second. A thin blue progress line at the top of the active meeting card slowly inches to the right.
